currentRoundInspection.method: Reference picture pixels inspected; standard viewer PMTiles used for approximate location, orientation and terrain fit.
currentRoundInspection.placement: Reference picture shows the high round keep, roofless hall and gatehouse silhouettes above a bounded riverside cliff. Retained east/south mapped controls and standard viewer PMTiles set approximate location, scale, orientation and coarse ground. Reconstructed court floor atY8 stays above coarse terrain; the cliff base reaches the same PMTiles sampler at all levels. The Wogan mouth is an approximate exterior feature; the original detailed section and master remain preserved. Anchor -4.920555555,51.676944444; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 10.602262091697735m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.
